# hyperfluid_pipeline (Resource)

A data pipeline, declared as the body `hfctl pipelines create --spec` takes. Runs are actions and stay out of Terraform.

~> Only `suspended` and `max_duration_minutes` change in place: any other change deletes the pipeline and its run history.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "documents_container_id" {
  description = "Id of the Iceberg data container that receives the extracted documents."
  type        = string
}

# Converts the documents dropped in a bucket to Markdown, into an Iceberg table.
resource "hyperfluid_pipeline" "invoices" {
  env      = data.hyperfluid_env.default.id
  name     = "invoices"
  type     = "trino"
  schedule = "*/30 * * * *"

  spec = jsonencode({
    pipeline_type = "markitdown"
    source = {
      type        = "harbor_bucket"
      bucket_name = hyperfluid_bucket.inbox.name
    }
    metadata_storage = {
      data_container_id = var.documents_container_id
      schema_name       = "documents"
      table_name        = "invoices"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id the pipeline runs in. Changing this forces a new pipeline.
- `name` (String) Pipeline name. Changing this forces a new pipeline.
- `spec` (String) The kind's request body as JSON (`jsonencode`), without `type` and `pipeline`; `harbor_bucket` references default to `env`. Not recovered by import.
- `type` (String) Kind of pipeline, the request's `type`: `trino`, `s3_copy`, `g_drive`… Not recovered by import.

### Optional

- `max_duration_minutes` (Number) Budget of one run in minutes, 1 to 1440. Left out, it follows the schedule. Not recovered by import.
- `schedule` (String) 5-field cron, or `one_off` for a single run. Defaults to the kind's own cadence. Changing this forces a new pipeline.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether scheduled runs are paused. Left out, it is not managed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pipeline_type` (String) What the pipeline runs, such as `markitdown`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pipeline import id is the pipeline id. `type`, `spec` and `max_duration_minutes`
# are not recovered: the first apply after the import records them from the configuration.
terraform import hyperfluid_pipeline.invoices 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
